decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Location Plan, Received 23 April 2012 
Un-numbered (amended existing floor plan), 02 (Amended existing/proposed elevation), 03 (Amended proposed ground floor plan), 04 (Amended proposed section), Received 6 June 2012 
 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house
